Keyed.MBBS_MoreTip: Buttons collapsed into the drawer. The drawer has its own settings button at the bottom.
Keyed.MBBS_ModSettings_InGame: Opened in a game: changes apply to the current save.
Keyed.MBBS_ModSettings_MainMenu: Opened from the main menu: changes apply to the default template that new games start with.
Keyed.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBar: Always draw the bar with this mod (for testing)
Keyed.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBarTip: Until you change something, the game keeps drawing the bar itself. Turn this on to compare this mod's drawing with the game's.
Keyed.MBBS_OriginallyHiddenTip: Buttons their mod keeps off the bar on purpose. Turn on "Always show" in Advanced to put one on the bar.
Keyed.MBBS_OrderHint: Top to bottom = left to right on screen. Drag rows to reorder.
Keyed.MBBS_NotShowingNowTip: Not on the bar right now: the button's own condition is not met.
Keyed.MBBS_FillScreenTip: When the buttons fit, stretch them to use the whole width.
Keyed.MBBS_MenuLocked: Lock the game menu button at the right end
Keyed.MBBS_MenuLockedTip: While locked, the menu button cannot be hidden, moved or put in the drawer; it can only be renamed.
Keyed.MBBS_MenuUnlockedNote: The game menu button has been unlocked in Advanced.
Keyed.MBBS_MenuLockedNote: The game menu button is locked at the right end and can only be renamed. Unlock it in Advanced, on the whole bar row.
Keyed.MBBS_Info_OriginallyHidden: Its mod keeps it off the bar on purpose; it appears only with "Always show".
Keyed.MBBS_ButtonWidthFollow: Width: same as the whole bar
Keyed.MBBS_ForceShowTip: Show the button even when its own condition says it should not appear. Clicking it may then do nothing.
Keyed.MBBS_TemplateSaved: Saved as the default template. New games will start with this arrangement.
Keyed.MBBS_ResetAllConfirm: Reset every setting to the untouched bar (the game plus what other mods changed)? This does not apply the template.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_TheirsNotice: Detected {0}: it currently controls the bar, so changes here take effect only when this mod has priority.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_OursNotice: Detected {0}: this mod has priority, so its effect on the bar is switched off.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_Ours_Desc: This mod draws the bar. {0}'s effect on the bar is switched off; its settings are only used as reference values.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_Theirs_Desc: {0} keeps the bar. This mod only keeps its settings window.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_RestartNeeded: Takes effect after restarting the game.
Keyed.MBBS_Compat_Imported: Imported the arrangement from {0}. Press Save to keep it.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyGameNote: Shared by all saves; the same key as in Options > Keyboard.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyCustomNote: Shared by all saves. This button has no entry in Options > Keyboard, so this mod keeps the key.
Keyed.MBBS_Export_ModXml: Copy as mod XML (for making an arrangement mod)
Keyed.MBBS_Export_ModXmlCopied: Def XML copied. Put it in a .xml file under your mod's Defs folder and change defName and label.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_Done: Arrangement imported into this window. Press Save to keep it.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_NotXml: That is not an exported arrangement (not valid XML).
Keyed.MBBS_Import_NoConfig: That text has no arrangement in it.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_Unsafe: That text asks to create program classes, which an arrangement never needs. Not imported.
Keyed.MBBS_Import_TooNew: Made by a newer version of this mod (format {0}; this version reads up to {1}). Update the mod first.
Keyed.MBBS_DrawerCellWidthFollow: Drawer cell width: same as the default button width
Keyed.MBBS_LabelAlignTip: Where button labels sit. Buttons that only show an icon are not affected.
Keyed.MBBS_ThemeHeaderTip: Themes change how the bar and its buttons look. Theme mods that list Main Button Bar System as a dependency appear here too. The choice is saved with this save (or with the template at the main menu).
Keyed.MBBS_ScrollArrowsNote: Arrows appear only when the buttons do not fit. While they fit, the bar does not need to scroll.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyConflictHeader: The key {0} is also used by:
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyConflictExplainGame: When two bindings share a key, pressing it triggers only one of them. Change one of them in Options > Keyboard, or pick another key here.
Keyed.MBBS_HotKeyConflictExplainCustom: This mod handles the keys it keeps after the game's own, so the bindings above take this key first and this button will not react. Pick another key here, or change the other binding in Options > Keyboard.

MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Vanilla.label: vanilla
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Vanilla.description: Like the base game: the screen width is shared equally. No scrolling and no drawer.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Collapse.label: collapse
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Collapse.description: Buttons marked "Drawer" move into the More drawer; the rest share the bar.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Scroll.label: scroll
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.Scroll.description: Buttons keep their width; scroll the bar with the mouse wheel or the arrows. The drawer is not used.
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.CollapseScroll.label: collapse + scroll
MainButtonBarSystem.BarDisplayModeDef.CollapseScroll.description: The drawer works as in Collapse; the remaining buttons scroll.
